name: Fisher Price Music Box Teaching Clock

pages.title: MATTEL Music Box Teaching Clock - Multi
pages.description: Introduced in 1968, the Fisher-Price Music Box Teaching Clock has made learning to tell time fun for generations of children. Designed as a little red schoolhouse, this educational toy will help your little ones to learn about time whilst having fun.
